input.task_text: Анна, владелица студии йоги, ищет дизайнера для лендинга в Figma. Нужны мобильная и десктопная версии, блок расписания и кнопка записи в существующий WhatsApp. Тексты и фото предоставит студия. Разработка сайта не входит. Предложение должно объяснить подход и следующий шаг, без цены и сроков до обсуждения.
input.freelancer_positioning: Я UI-дизайнер, работаю в Figma. Делал лендинги для небольших сервисных компаний, уделяю внимание читаемости и удобству записи. Портфолио могу показать на созвоне, конкретных результатов в процентах у меня нет.

output.text:
Здравствуйте, Анна!

Мой опыт с лендингами для небольших сервисных компаний и работа в Figma хорошо подходят для лендинга студии йоги. Особенно интересна задача сделать запись на занятия простой и заметной.

В работе уделю внимание читаемости и удобству записи. Подготовлю мобильную и десктопную версии, блок расписания и кнопку записи в существующий WhatsApp. Тексты и фото предоставит студия; разработка сайта останется за рамками этой работы.

Предлагаю созвониться: покажу портфолио и обсудим структуру лендинга.

input.task_text: Northlake Books needs a Shopify accessibility review, not a redesign. Audit 6 templates: home, collection, product, cart, search, contact. Deliver a prioritized issue spreadsheet with reproduction steps and a 45-minute handover. Check keyboard use, focus, labels and contrast against WCAG 2.2 AA. No certification or legal compliance guarantee. We can provide staging access on 8 October 2026; the report is needed by 16 October if access arrives on time. Theme edits, third-party checkout and app remediation are excluded. Budget ceiling USD 1,200; final fee must be agreed after inspecting the theme.
input.freelancer_positioning: I am a frontend developer who has performed manual keyboard and screen-reader checks on two ecommerce projects. I use browser devtools and axe as aids, and document limitations clearly. I am not a certified accessibility auditor and have no Shopify Plus experience.

gaps.description: My stated experience does not cover accessibility reviews on Shopify.
My stated experience does not cover auditing against WCAG 2.2 AA, including contrast.

output.text:
Hello,

On two ecommerce projects, I performed manual keyboard and screen-reader checks; I use browser devtools and axe as aids, and document limitations clearly.

I will review the home, collection, product, cart, search, and contact templates for keyboard use, focus, labels, and contrast against WCAG 2.2 AA. Deliverables are a prioritized issue spreadsheet with reproduction steps and a 45-minute handover. This is a review, not a redesign, and includes no certification or legal compliance guarantee. Theme edits, third-party checkout, and app remediation are outside this work.

Staging access must be provided on 8 October 2026 before work starts. The requested report deadline is 16 October 2026, conditional on access arriving on time. The USD 1,200 budget ceiling is your proposal, not an agreed fee; the final fee remains to be agreed after inspecting the theme. Please provide staging access on 8 October so the review can proceed.

input.task_text: A client wants a fully custom 12-page Webflow site within 48 hours for EUR 300, while also insisting every page be approved before build. Copy and images will only arrive next week. They ask for unlimited revisions and a guaranteed top-3 Google ranking. Write a respectful proposal that identifies these conflicts, declines the ranking guarantee and unlimited revisions, and offers discussion of a smaller first phase. Do not accept the stated deadline or invent a replacement budget.
input.freelancer_positioning: I build Webflow marketing sites and can scope work after reviewing content. My past work includes small business sites, but I have no search-ranking case studies. I only commit to timelines once dependencies and review rounds are agreed.

output.text:
Hello,

My past work includes small business sites, and I build Webflow marketing sites. I do not accept the 48-hour deadline: copy and images arrive next week, and every page must be approved before build.

EUR 300 is your proposed budget, not an agreed price. I do not accept unlimited revisions or offer a guaranteed top-3 Google ranking. I can discuss a smaller first phase, with its page scope and review rounds defined before work begins.

Once the copy and images arrive next week, send them and the pages you would prioritize; I can scope the first phase after reviewing the content.

Включён один раунд исправления ошибок перевода в течение 5 рабочих дней; изменение оригинала оплачивается отдельно. До начала работы необходимо получить глоссарий и финальный оригинал.
